SINK: creating files and directories on the filesystem
GUARD: reject absolute dest_path; normalize dest_path and raise an error if it escapes the resolved destination; walk each member of the tar archive, resolve its target, and raise an error unless the fully resolved target remains inside dest_path; a symbolic link or hard link whose resolved target stays inside dest_path may be extracted

EFFECT: extract the tar archive beneath dest_path and return True only when extraction completes successfully
END_PLAN
